title: Kusner 的 taxicab 等距集猜想：首个开放维数 n=5
summary: The original yes/no problem remains open. The strongest frozen result is an independently audited partial theorem: every hypothetical eleven-point equilateral set in l1^5 has at least 19 positive consecutive coordinate gaps, hence at least 24 total coordinate levels. A separate exact finite certificate proves maximum 10 only in the box {0,1,2,3,4}^5.
solution_percent_basis: The work gives a substantial new necessary condition and eliminates all support strata t<=18, but it neither excludes all t>=19 branches nor constructs eleven points, so it does not resolve the original conjecture.
confidence_percent_basis: The stated partial theorem has a complete human proof, exact rational/integer finite checks, referee rounds 1-5, a final hash-bound adversarial referee PASS, fail-closed optimization/isolation matrices, and a clean citation/LaTeX/PDF audit. The remaining uncertainty concerns bounded literature novelty, not the internal theorem.

exact_result.statement: If eleven equilateral points in l1^5 exist and q_j is the number of coordinate-j levels, then sum_j(q_j-1)>=19 and sum_j q_j>=24.
exact_result.scope: Structural necessary condition only; Kusner n=5 remains open.
exact_result.finite_box: The maximum equilateral subset of {0,1,2,3,4}^5 is 10; this does not imply the unrestricted theorem.

evidence: proof/builder_notes.md and proof/structural_reduction.md give the exact cut-chain, Parseval, Naimark, and spectral-deficit reductions.
